foundation.title: Frontend foundation
foundation.description: FE-0 foundation only. No business screens are implemented. Layout, tokens, typography, direction and the component library are active on this route.

login.title: Sign in
login.contractMissingBody: The GPMS API contract has not been published, so sign-in cannot complete. This form is the finished foundation; only the endpoint is missing.
login.demoBody: The real API is not configured, so sign-in uses sample accounts. Use admin@rental.test, owner@grids.test, manager@grids.test or tenant@grids.test with any password.

unexpected.description: This page could not be displayed. Trying again may resolve it.

properties.title: Properties
properties.tableCaption: List of properties with reference, classification, location and unit count
properties.emptyDescription: Add your first property to start building the inventory that listings, leases and maintenance all depend on.
properties.deleteDescription: This removes the property record. Units and buildings that reference it may be affected.

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.tableCaption: List of buildings with reference, parent property, floor count and unit count
buildings.emptyDescription: Buildings group floors and units within a property.
buildings.floorsCaption: Floors in this building with level and unit count
buildings.noFloorsDescription: Floors organise units within a building.

units.title: Units
units.tableCaption: List of units with reference, type, property, availability status, area and price
units.emptyDescription: Units are the inventory that listings link to and that leases are signed against.
units.deleteDescription: This removes the unit record. Leases or invoices that reference it may be affected.

field.name: Name
field.statusHelp: Occupied and unavailable units cannot be advertised.
field.ownerIdHelp: Numeric ID of an existing owner record. Required by the API.
field.moneyHelp: Enter the amount without a currency symbol.
field.currencyNote: Currency is set for the whole system; the API does not store a currency per unit yet.

detail.timelineUnavailableBody: The API does not yet expose an occupancy timeline for units. The current status above is live.

listings.title: Listings
listings.tableCaption: List of listings with reference, type, state, property, price, views and enquiries
listings.emptyDescription: A listing advertises a unit. Create one from a property or unit in the inventory.

approvals.title: Approval queue
approvals.tableCaption: Listings awaiting review or approval, with state and submission time
approvals.emptyDescription: Listings submitted for review will appear here.

projects.title: Projects
projects.tableCaption: List of projects with reference, developer, city and available units
projects.emptyDescription: Projects group new-development inventory by unit type.
projects.inventoryCaption: Unit types with totals, availability, area range and price range

form.assetSeparationNote: A listing advertises an asset; it does not replace it. Availability, occupancy and billing stay with the asset and the contract.

media.removeDescription: It will no longer appear on the listing.
media.emptyDescription: Images, floor plans and tours will appear here.

leads.title: Leads
leads.tableCaption: List of leads with stage, source, assigned agent, budget and next action
leads.emptyDescription: Leads arrive from the website, the mobile app, calls and imports, or you can add one manually.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.moveFailed: The stage could not be changed.

activities.title: Tasks and activities
activities.tableCaption: Tasks and reminders with type, due date, owner and completion status
activities.emptyDescription: Calls, notes, meetings, tasks and reminders appear here.

matches.title: Matching properties
matches.noticeTitle: Matches are calculated by the platform
matches.noticeBody: Scores and reasons come from the platform's matching rules, not from this screen.
matches.emptyDescription: No listings currently meet this lead's stated criteria.

viewings.title: Viewings
viewings.tableCaption: Viewing appointments with lead, listing, time, agent and status
viewings.emptyDescription: Viewing appointments will appear here once booked.
viewings.calendarNoticeBody: A week or month grid needs the first day of the week to be decided for the launch markets. The daily schedule is correct whichever way that goes.
viewings.actionsBlockedTitle: Attendance actions are not available yet
viewings.actionsBlockedBody: Recording attendance, a no-show or a reschedule are status changes, and the rules for who may make them have not been defined.

offers.title: Offers
offers.tableCaption: Offers with lead, listing, amount, status and expiry
offers.emptyDescription: Offers submitted against listings will appear here.
offers.approvalBlockedBody: Offer approval and deposit handling are financial actions and are waiting on the finance module.

deals.title: Deals
deals.tableCaption: Closed deals with lead, listing, value, outcome and close date
deals.emptyDescription: Deals appear here once a lead reaches a won or lost outcome.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.tableCaption: Commission entries by deal, party, amount, rule and settlement status
commissions.emptyDescription: Commission entries appear once deals are closed.
commissions.calculationNoticeTitle: Amounts are calculated by the platform
commissions.calculationNoticeBody: This screen displays commission amounts as calculated by the configured rules. It performs no calculation of its own.
